trajectories.title: Versioned metadata admission
trajectories.reason: Zarr v3, attributes.ome, explicit 0.5 product boundary and hierarchy consistency survive both finals; no supported version-admission fact is deleted.

trajectories.title: Declared arrays/axis identity and pyramid order
trajectories.reason: Group-relative declared paths, largest/highest-resolution first, arbitrary names, rank/order and dimension_names survive. No fixed numbered-folder or factor-of-two policy is introduced.

trajectories.title: Absent versus singleton dimensions
trajectories.reason: Optional-axis and rank premises are present, but neither seed nor any completed verifier version develops absent-vs-present-length-one control identity. This is not a draft-to-final loss.

trajectories.title: Overbroad untyped tolerance and position inference
trajectories.reason: The seed has both type:space composition requirements and missing-type/position inference. Both verifiers affirm this mixture without resolving the specific 2/3-space constraint. The error predates these verifier drafts.

trajectories.title: Per-level scale/translation and global-after-dataset rule
trajectories.reason: Correct source rule and sample scale arithmetic are present in seed and both finals. Semantic preservation of this rule does not validate the contradictory notation also in seed/R012.

trajectories.title: Within-list composition notation
trajectories.reason: The seed already writes global(scale∘translate) ∘ perLevel(scale∘translate). R012 carries it unchanged into V002 and every later report. R011 omits the formula but affirms U005 composition/arithmetic, leaving the unsupported seed notation unflagged. It is not a new R012 invention or a proved valid formula lost from R011.

trajectories.title: Concrete nonzero-translation expected result
trajectories.reason: Translation order and valid UNEXECUTED V5 proposals are acquired. No seed or available completed report develops a nonzero-offset worked expectation capable of catching reversal/offset omission. Missing execution fixtures do not invalidate the proposals.

trajectories.title: Multi-axis composition treated as unresolved because no worked example
trajectories.reason: Absence of another worked example is true; the generic composition rule is still specified. R012 N-25 limit says multi-axis behavior beyond time unresolved; R011 unresolved-area list also includes multi-axis composition. This additional uncertainty weakens a supported general rule rather than documenting a measured implementation gap.

trajectories.title: Units and truthful unknown calibration
trajectories.reason: Both retain unknown/no-unit disclosure and no invented units. Unit absence alone proving relative rather than physical scale and channel-never-meaningful scaling remain overstatements inherited from seed, not new supported findings.

trajectories.title: Label discovery/count/integer categorical premises
trajectories.reason: Intermediate folders, declared label paths, multiscales, equal level count, integer categorical values and label-value identity survive semantically. R011 summarizes rather than rendering all exact dtype tokens.

trajectories.title: 64-bit exact categorical identity
trajectories.reason: The seed names uint64/int64 and labels by integer value. R012 retains all eight dtype spellings; R011 final report contains none of those spellings. Neither develops binary64 precision avoidance/exact supported range or sparse/scrambled ID checks. The source premise is acquired; its required identity implications remain undeveloped.

trajectories.title: Label source association restricted to provenance
trajectories.reason: The seed already says follow source.image only to annotate provenance, not relocate overlay. R012 retains that rule; R011 summarizes provenance rules under SUPPORTED without identifying the association defect. No correct source-resolution requirement is observed earlier and then lost.

trajectories.title: Label coordinate-system and lower-case should force
trajectories.reason: Seed quotes the same-coordinate-system relationship but doubts force because overview/usually. R012 repeats this and N-26; R011 compresses it to usually same system, moving the qualifier from shapes/transforms to the coordinate-system relation. Source lower-case should is normative recommended force, not force-free overview prose.

trajectories.title: image-label colors/version SHOULD upgraded to key-presence MUST
trajectories.reason: Seed explicitly makes version string MUST be present; both finals affirm it. This is inherited force error, not valid optional-field content correctly rejected.

trajectories.title: Recommended label palette and categorical resampling policy
trajectories.reason: Reader SHOULD specified colors, value-keyed lookup, rgba/alpha, optional properties/source and categorical/noninterpolating policy survive. Nearest-neighbor is correctly presented as a product choice; mandatory legends/property presentation remains an unsupported elevation.

trajectories.title: No Zarr-feature disallowance despite acquired integer-only labels
trajectories.reason: The seed contains both the no-disallowance conclusion and integer-only label restriction. Both verifiers preserve both without resolving the inconsistency; R012 N-01 scopes searches but still falsely confirms the negative. This is acquired counterevidence left unused, not inaccessible evidence.

trajectories.title: No color/window semantics beyond presence
trajectories.reason: Seed includes six-hex RGB and then denies semantics beyond presence. Both affirm the denial despite available meanings/format constraints; R012 N-15 also acknowledges RGB then confirms the broad absence. No gamma/registry rule is the narrower supported absence.

trajectories.title: Absent omero implies no embedded display defaults universally
trajectories.reason: Intensity defaults are a legitimate product question. The blanket assertion ignores independently supplied image-label colors. R012 adds N-16 scoped confirmation; neither repairs the overbreadth.

trajectories.title: Actual implementations unavailable versus incompatibility
trajectories.reason: The source Tools pointer and absence of measured reader behavior are preserved. Unopened implementation evidence is outside the admitted source set, not a supported fact removed by the verifier.

trajectories.title: No tool names or versions in source
trajectories.reason: R012 negative-checks counterevidence claims no tool names/versions although its own acquisition keyword version inventory records skimage 0.16.1 at L379 and seed U004 mentions skimage. bioformats2raw is also ubiquitous. This new negative is directly counterevidenced within acquired content.

trajectories.title: Read-only, local scope and item-scoped truthful unsupported behavior
trajectories.reason: Both keep source-unchanged/session-local, explain undisplayable data, and separate product boundary from format nonconformance. No unsupported input is proved malformed merely because a fileset was not supplied.

trajectories.title: Derived opening/listing rules versus literal source MUST
trajectories.reason: R011 expressly classifies plate-first synthesis and labels exclusion as derivations. Both soften directory-scan nonconformance to inference. This is valid provenance/force correction and not false rejection of metadata authority; auxiliary scanning still is not explicitly prohibited.

trajectories.title: Informative example terminology
